Off limits? I thought you demonrats screamed to the heavens that “no one was. above the law?” And yet here you are, nonchalantly stating schiff is off limits because he’s a senator….
And he is in violation of the Logan Act.
“ governments.

Influencing another nation on world news, particularly when it against the interests of the US to do so, puts him violation.
